name: כַּלְנֵה
summary: Calneh is a city in the land of Shinar, listed with Babel, Erech and Akkad at the beginning of Nimrod’s kingdom. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: Calneh is the last of four places listed before בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר, “in the land of Shinar.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `kkaleneeh` (old root key כלנה).
